audit_definitions.F1_raw: sum_b n_b (gradient_deltaW mean(CE_b))^2 / N; native batch-gradient-square proxy on old fit data; NOT per-example empirical Fisher
audit_definitions.B2: Task2 endpoint native new-task fit data batch-gradient proxy raw trace; NOT old-task Fisher and NOT accumulated saved Fisher
audit_definitions.Fisher_saved_after_Task2: .9 F1_raw + F2_raw; does not affect already completed Task2 training
audit_definitions.gradient_ratio: mean of 51 observed norm(P)/norm(clean CE) ratios across actual trainable parameters, clean heads included; GAM clean cache is not GAM direction
audit_definitions.statistics: three fixed seeds; sample standard deviation ddof1; CIL matrix entries saved to 2 decimal places
